mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.disable.to: Uses Sodium's normal terrain renderer for the rest of this game session. This switch intentionally resets when Minecraft is restarted.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.temporal_h: Uses Vulkan task shaders and the previous frame's hierarchical depth buffer to reject hidden Sodium terrain workgroups. The direct mesh-shader path remains available when unsupported.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.packed_geo: Re-encodes Sodium's 20-byte chunk vertices into a 16-byte Arc format. This lowers terrain bandwidth at the cost of maintaining a fallback copy in Sodium's arenas.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.sparse_res: Backs the packed terrain arena with Vulkan sparse buffer pages when the selected GPU supports them. Dense pages are used as a fallback.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.custom_tra: Consumes Sodium's sorted translucent index data with a dedicated Vulkan mesh pipeline. Disable this to let Sodium render translucent terrain normally.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.keep_dista: Keeps previously compiled solid and cutout terrain in the Arc arena and draws it within this distance. It does not load new chunks or retain translucent sorting data. Larger values use more GPU memory.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.automatic_: Chooses a conservative packed-geometry budget from the selected GPU's device-local memory. Disable this to use Max GPU Memory directly.
mesh-shaders-with-arc.options.max_gpu_me: Sets the memory budget for packed terrain geometry. When the budget is reached, terrain outside Keep Distance is reclaimed first. Applying this option rebuilds terrain rendering resources.
